items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember playing once with Connie Francis... [INTERVIEWEE] Same guy? Oh that’s great.

ctx.x: Right, the same jokes. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

I remember playing once with Connie Francis and some guy in the audience said, “We love you Connie.” And we all thought that was such a nice thing. And the next night some guy in the audience goes, “We love you Connie,” it was the same guy.
